verdict.rationale: RevenueCat's webhooks docs explicitly state it notifies developers of any app event in real time (renewals, cancellations, etc.), corroborated by GitHub SDK description of 'real-time events through webhooks,' and CustomerInfo/API docs support reliable state retrieval as a fallback. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on evidence of webhook reliability at scale (e.g., retries, delivery guarantees) and one community comment requests additional timed-hook notifications not yet covered.
